dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Thin, pale-grey margins are visible on the distal edges of the folded flight feathers, providing a distinct contrast against the darker grey-brown feather bodies.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast plumage features include a prominent white rectangular patch on the rump and upper tail coverts, followed by a tail with four distinct, alternating dark-grey and white horizontal bands.
